title: Battle of Evesham
text: During the Second Barons' War, a decisive military confrontation known as the Battle of Evesham took place. The royal army led by Prince Edward, the future king Edward I of England, engaged the rebellious forces of Simon de Montfort, 6th Earl of Leicester. This fierce conflict resulted in a crushing defeat for the rebels, with de Montfort and many of his key allies killed on the battlefield.
